recipes.title: Banana Cake (Loaf or Round Tin)
recipes.description: A versatile banana cake batter that fits perfectly in either a standard loaf tin or a normal round cake tin.
equipment: loaf tin or round cake tin

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C. Grease and line your chosen tin (loaf tin or round cake tin).

steps.title: Mash & Mix
steps.text: Mash the bananas in a bowl. Stir in the melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla extract.

steps.title: Dry Ingredients
steps.text: Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir. Fold in the flour until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour the batter into the tin. For a loaf tin, bake for 50-60 minutes. For a round tin, bake for 35-45 minutes. It is done when a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

notes: The round tin bakes faster because the batter is spread thinner than in a deep loaf tin.
Source recipe adapted from: https://www.simplyrecipes.com/recipes/banana_bread/

recipes.title: Beer-Battered Fish
recipes.description: Crispy beer-battered fish fillets for a homemade Fish and Chips experience (fish only). Ingredients adapted for Prague supermarkets.
equipment: deep frying pan or heavy pot

ingredients.name: cod or haddock fillets (filety z tresky, fresh or thawed)
cold light beer (studené světlé pivo, e.g., Pilsner)
sunflower or rapeseed oil for frying (slunečnicový nebo řepkový olej)
extra flour for dusting (mouka na obalení)

steps.title: Prep Fish
steps.text: Pat the fish fillets completely dry with paper towels. Cut them into 4 equal portions.

steps.title: Heat Oil
steps.text: Pour the oil into a deep pan or pot and heat it to 180°C (or until a drop of batter sizzles and floats immediately).

steps.title: Make Batter
steps.text: In a bowl, mix the 150g flour, baking powder, and salt. Pour in the cold beer and whisk gently until a thick batter forms. A few lumps are fine.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Dust the fish pieces lightly in the extra flour, then dip them into the beer batter, letting the excess drip off.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Carefully lower the battered fish away from you into the hot oil. Fry for about 4 to 5 minutes, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden brown.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Remove the fish with a slotted spoon and let it rest on paper towels to drain excess oil. Serve immediately.

notes: Using ice-cold beer is crucial as the thermal shock against the hot oil creates a crispier batter.
Source recipe adapted from: https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/golden-beer-battered-fish-with-chips

recipes.title: Taiwanese XXL Fried Chicken (Shihlin Style)
recipes.description: Crispy, pounded flat chicken breast coated in starch and five-spice, inspired by Shihlin street food.
recipes.time: 15 min prep + 30 min marinate + 10 min cook
equipment: meat mallet or rolling pin (palička na maso)

ingredients.name: rice wine or water (rýžové víno nebo voda)
tapioca starch or potato starch (tapiokový nebo bramborový škrob)

steps.title: Prep Chicken
steps.text: Butterfly the chicken breasts. Place them between cling film and pound them flat to about 0.5 cm thickness.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix soy sauce, rice wine, garlic, sugar, 0.5 tsp five-spice powder, and 0.25 tsp white pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Seasoning Mix
steps.text: In a small bowl, mix the salt, chili powder, remaining 0.5 tsp five-spice powder, and remaining 0.5 tsp white pepper. Set aside.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Dredge the marinated chicken in the tapioca starch, pressing down firmly so it sticks. Let it sit for 5 minutes until the starch looks slightly damp.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat oil to 180°C. Carefully fry the chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until crisp and golden brown.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Drain on paper towels. Immediately dust generously on both sides with the seasoning mix. Serve hot and whole.

notes: Tapioca starch provides the authentic crunchy crust. It is easily found in Prague's Asian markets (like Sapa) or large supermarkets. Potato starch is a good fallback.
Source recipe adapted from: https://thewoksoflife.com/taiwanese-fried-chicken/

recipes.title: Classic Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Simple, fluffy blueberry muffins suitable for a quick breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen blueberries (čerstvé nebo mražené borůvky)

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Line a muffin tin with paper liners.

steps.title: Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.

steps.title: Wet Ingredients
steps.text: In a separate measuring jug, whisk the oil, egg, and milk.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir with a fork or spatula just until combined. Do not overmix; the batter should be lumpy.

steps.title: Add Blueberries
steps.text: Gently fold in the blueberries.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

notes: If using frozen blueberries, do not thaw them beforehand, as they will bleed into the batter.
Source recipe adapted from: https://www.inspiredtaste.net/18982/our-favorite-easy-blueberry-muffin-recipe/

recipes.title: Classic Vanilla Cupcakes with Buttercream
recipes.description: Soft and tender vanilla cupcakes topped with a simple vanilla buttercream frosting.

ingredients.name: milk or heavy cream (mléko nebo smetana - for buttercream)

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175°C. Line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper liners.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar
steps.text: In a large bowl, use a mixer on medium speed to beat the 115g softened butter and 200g sugar until pale and fluffy (about 3 minutes).

steps.title: Add Wet Ingredients
steps.text: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each. Stir in the 2 tsp vanilla extract.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: On low speed, add a third of the dry ingredients, followed by half the milk. Repeat, ending with the dry ingredients. Mix just until combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Fill the liners about 2/3 full. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

steps.title: Make Buttercream
steps.text: Beat the remaining 115g softened butter on medium speed until creamy. Gradually add the icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla, and 1 tbsp milk. Beat on high for 2 minutes until fluffy.

steps.title: Frost
steps.text: Once the cupcakes are completely cool, pipe or spread the buttercream on top.

notes: Make sure the cupcakes are completely cold before frosting, otherwise the buttercream will melt.
Source recipe adapted from: https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/simply-sweet-vanilla-cupcakes/

recipes.title: Simple Cocoa Brownies
recipes.description: Fudgy, dense brownies made entirely with everyday cocoa powder.
equipment: square baking tin (čtvercová forma na pečení)

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175°C. Grease an 8x8-inch (20x20 cm) square tin and line it with baking paper.

steps.title: Wet Ingredients
steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk the melted butter and sugar together until well combined. Whisk in the eggs and vanilla extract until the mixture is smooth and slightly lighter in color.

steps.title: Dry Ingredients
steps.text: Sift the cocoa powder, flour, and salt directly into the bowl. Fold gently with a spatula just until the dry ingredients are fully incorporated. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour the thick batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Allow the brownies to cool completely in the tin before lifting them out and slicing.

notes: Using Dutch-processed cocoa powder (holandské kakao) gives a darker, richer flavor.
Source recipe adapted from: https://cafedelites.com/best-fudgy-cocoa-brownies/

recipes.title: Simple Homemade Hot Cocoa
recipes.description: A quick, comforting mug of hot chocolate using basic pantry cocoa powder.

steps.title: Make a Paste
steps.text: In the small saucepan, whisk together the cocoa powder, sugar, salt, and about 2 tablespoons of the milk until you form a smooth, dark paste. This prevents lumps.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Gradually whisk in the rest of the milk. Place the saucepan over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Heat gently, whisking frequently, until the cocoa is steaming hot but not boiling.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Remove from heat, stir in the vanilla extract, and pour into a mug.

notes: You can substitute any plant-based milk (almond, oat) if preferred.
Source recipe adapted from: https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/simple-hot-cocoa-395711

recipes.title: Bubur Kacang Hijau (Mung Bean Porridge)
recipes.description: Sweet and comforting Indonesian mung bean porridge with coconut milk. Ingredients easily found in Prague supermarkets.

ingredients.name: pandan leaves (pandanové listy - from Asian markets) OR 1 tsp vanilla extract (vanilkový extrakt)
palm sugar or brown sugar (palmový nebo třtinový cukr)

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Wash the mung beans and soak them in water for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Drain before cooking.

steps.title: Boil Beans
steps.text: In a large pot, bring the 1L of water to a boil. Add the soaked mung beans, crushed ginger, and pandan leaves (if using).

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Lower the heat and simmer for about 30-40 minutes until the beans are completely soft and bursting.

steps.title: Sweeten
steps.text: Add the sugar, salt, and vanilla extract (if using instead of pandan). Stir until the sugar is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Coconut Milk
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk. Stir gently and let it simmer for another 5 minutes. Do not let it boil vigorously so the coconut milk doesn't split.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove the ginger and pandan leaves. Serve warm in bowls.

notes: Mung beans are widely available in Czech supermarkets, typically in the healthy food or legumes aisle.
Source recipe adapted from: https://dailycookingquest.com/bubur-kacang-hijau-mung-bean-porridge.html

recipes.title: Beef Rendang (Prague Supermarket Edition)
recipes.description: Indonesian beef rendang adapted to use ingredients easily sourced in standard Czech supermarkets.
equipment: heavy-bottomed pot or wok (těžký hrnec nebo wok)

ingredients.name: beef chuck or stewing beef, cut into cubes (hovězí krk nebo hovězí na guláš)
desiccated coconut (strouhaný kokos - to make kerisik)
dried lime leaves (sušené limetkové lístky - check spice aisle)
yellow onions or 4 shallots (cibule nebo šalotka)
fresh ginger (čerstvý zázvor - substituting for galangal/ginger mix)

steps.title: Make Kerisik
steps.text: Dry toast the desiccated coconut in a pan over medium-low heat until it turns dark golden brown. Let it cool, then blend or pound it until it releases its oils and becomes a paste.

steps.title: Spice Paste
steps.text: Blend the onions, garlic, chilies, ginger, turmeric, coriander, cumin, and a splash of oil or water into a smooth paste.

steps.title: Fry Aromatics
steps.text: Heat oil in the pot. Fry the spice paste along with the lemongrass, lime leaves, cinnamon, and cloves for 5 minutes until fragrant and the oil begins to separate.

steps.title: Brown Meat
steps.text: Add the beef cubes. Stir well to coat the meat in the spices and cook until the outside is browned.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk. Bring to a gentle boil, then lower the heat. Simmer uncovered for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Reduce and Caramelize
steps.text: Add the toasted coconut paste (kerisik), brown sugar, lime juice, and salt. Continue cooking for another 45-60 minutes. Stir frequently as the liquid evaporates and the oils separate, allowing the meat to fry in the spiced oil until dark brown and tender.

notes: Authentic rendang uses galangal and tamarind, but ginger and lime juice provide a highly accessible supermarket alternative.
Source recipe adapted from: https://rasamalaysia.com/beef-rendang-recipe-rendang-daging/

title: Candied Fruit Loaf Cake
Kue Loaf Buah Kering
description: Simple buttery loaf cake to use up leftover candied fruit mix (e.g. Belbake).
Kue loaf mentega yang sederhana untuk menghabiskan sisa campuran buah kering manisan (misalnya Belbake).
oven: 160°C top & bottom heat, no fan (glass tin)
160°C api atas & bawah, tanpa kipas (loyang kaca)

name: baking powder (prášek do pečiva), a bit less than half a packet
baking powder (prášek do pečiva), sedikit kurang dari setengah bungkus
candied fruit mix (100-200 g works)
campuran buah kering manisan (100-200 g bisa)
extra flour, to coat the fruit
tepung tambahan, untuk membalur buah

title: Prep
Persiapan
text: Heat the oven to 160°C, top and bottom heat, no fan. Grease the tin and line it with baking paper.
Panaskan oven 160°C, api atas dan bawah, tanpa kipas. Olesi loyang dengan mentega dan alasi dengan kertas roti.

title: Coat the fruit
Balur buah
text: Toss the candied fruit with 1 tbsp flour so it doesn't sink.
Aduk buah kering dengan 1 sdm tepung supaya tidak tenggelam ke dasar.

title: Cream
Kocok mentega
text: With the flat beater on medium, beat butter, sugar and vanilla sugar for about 3 minutes until pale and fluffy.
Dengan pengaduk pipih di kecepatan sedang, kocok mentega, gula, dan gula vanili sekitar 3 menit sampai pucat dan mengembang.

title: Eggs
Telur
text: Add the eggs one at a time on medium speed.
Masukkan telur satu per satu dengan kecepatan sedang.

title: Batter
Adonan
text: Mix flour, baking powder and salt. On the lowest speed, add half the flour, then the milk, then the rest. Stop as soon as it's combined.
Campur tepung, baking powder, dan garam. Dengan kecepatan paling rendah, masukkan setengah tepung, lalu susu, lalu sisa tepung. Berhenti begitu tercampur rata.

title: Fruit
Buah
text: Fold in the fruit by hand with a spatula. Spread in the tin.
Aduk balik buah dengan spatula secara manual. Ratakan di loyang.

title: Bake
Panggang
text: Bake on the middle rack. Start checking with a skewer at 35-40 min; usually done at 50-60 min. If the top browns too fast, cover loosely with foil.
Panggang di rak tengah. Mulai cek dengan tusuk sate di menit 35-40; biasanya matang di menit 50-60. Kalau atasnya terlalu cepat cokelat, tutup longgar dengan aluminium foil.

title: Cool
Dinginkan
text: Cool 10 min in the tin, then on a rack. Don't put the hot glass tin on a cold or wet surface.
Diamkan 10 menit di loyang, lalu pindahkan ke rak. Jangan taruh loyang kaca panas di permukaan dingin atau basah.

notes: Lemon or orange zest goes well with it.
Parutan kulit lemon atau jeruk cocok ditambahkan.
Glaze: 4 tbsp powdered sugar + 1 tbsp lemon juice, drizzled over the cooled cake.
Glasur: 4 sdm gula halus + 1 sdm air lemon, siramkan di atas kue yang sudah dingin.
No mixer: melt the butter, whisk with sugar, eggs and milk, then stir in the dry ingredients and fruit.
Tanpa mixer: lelehkan mentega, kocok dengan gula, telur, dan susu, lalu aduk bahan kering dan buah.

title: Arsik Kapr (Batak Carp Arsik)
Arsik Ikan Mas (Kapr)
description: Arsik ikan mas made with Czech carp, simmered in a yellow turmeric and Sichuan-pepper paste with beans and lemongrass. Simplified: no kecombrang or asam cikala.
Arsik ikan mas dengan ikan kapr Ceko, dimasak dengan bumbu kuning kunyit dan lada Sichuan, bersama buncis dan serai. Versi sederhana: tanpa kecombrang dan asam cikala.

name: carp (kapr), about 1-1.2 kg, cleaned and cut in 4 pieces, or 800 g carp/trout fillets
ikan mas (kapr), sekitar 1-1,2 kg, dibersihkan dan dipotong 4, atau 800 g fillet ikan mas/trout
macadamia nuts (instead of kemiri), for the paste
kacang macadamia (pengganti kemiri), untuk bumbu halus
ground turmeric (kurkuma), or 3 cm fresh, for the paste
kunyit bubuk (kurkuma), atau 3 cm kunyit segar, untuk bumbu halus
galangal (or 1 tsp galangal powder), for the paste
lengkuas (atau 1 sdt lengkuas bubuk), untuk bumbu halus
Sichuan pepper, toasted (instead of andaliman), for the paste
lada Sichuan, disangrai (pengganti andaliman), untuk bumbu halus
red chilies, for the paste (fewer for milder)
cabai merah, untuk bumbu halus (kurangi supaya tidak terlalu pedas)
green beans (fazolové lusky) or long beans, in 5 cm pieces
buncis (fazolové lusky) atau kacang panjang, potong 5 cm
lime juice, to finish (instead of asam cikala)
air jeruk nipis, untuk akhir (pengganti asam cikala)

title: Marinate
Marinasi
text: Rub the fish with lime juice and salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Lumuri ikan dengan air jeruk nipis dan garam. Diamkan 15 menit.

title: Paste
Bumbu halus
text: Toast the Sichuan pepper in a dry pan for 1 minute. Put all paste ingredients in the chopper and blitz to a fairly smooth paste, adding a splash of water if needed.
Sangrai lada Sichuan di wajan kering selama 1 menit. Masukkan semua bahan bumbu ke chopper dan haluskan, tambahkan sedikit air kalau perlu.

title: Layer
Susun
text: In a wide pan, lay the beans and lemongrass on the bottom, then the fish on top. Mix the paste with the water and pour over. Add the lime leaves.
Di wajan lebar, susun buncis dan serai di dasar, lalu ikan di atasnya. Campur bumbu halus dengan air dan tuang di atasnya. Masukkan daun jeruk.

title: Simmer
Masak perlahan
text: Cover and simmer on low heat for 30-40 minutes. Don't stir; spoon the sauce over the fish now and then and gently shake the pan. The sauce should reduce to a thick yellow gravy.
Tutup dan masak dengan api kecil selama 30-40 menit. Jangan diaduk; sesekali siram ikan dengan kuahnya dan goyangkan wajan perlahan. Kuah akan menyusut jadi kuah kuning yang kental.

title: Finish
Selesaikan
text: Add the spring onions and lime juice in the last 5 minutes. Taste for salt. Serve with rice.
Masukkan daun bawang dan air jeruk nipis di 5 menit terakhir. Cicipi garamnya. Sajikan dengan nasi.

notes: Carp has many small bones; trout (pstruh) is easier and cooks in about 20 minutes.
Ikan mas banyak durinya; ikan trout (pstruh) lebih mudah dan matang sekitar 20 menit.
Live and fresh carp are easiest to find in December; frozen carp portions are sold year-round in bigger supermarkets.
Ikan mas hidup dan segar paling mudah dicari di bulan Desember; potongan ikan mas beku dijual sepanjang tahun di supermarket besar.
Sichuan pepper is a close relative of andaliman and gives the same tingly feeling.
Lada Sichuan masih kerabat dekat andaliman dan memberi rasa getir-kebas yang sama.

items: Sichuan pepper, galangal, lemongrass, lime leaves, long beans
lada Sichuan, lengkuas, serai, daun jeruk, kacang panjang
where: Sapa market (Praha-Libuš) or Asian grocery shops

items: carp, trout, green beans, shallots, macadamia, ground turmeric
ikan mas, trout, buncis, bawang merah, macadamia, kunyit bubuk
where: regular supermarkets (Albert, Tesco, Kaufland, Billa, Lidl)
supermarket biasa (Albert, Tesco, Kaufland, Billa, Lidl)

title: Saksang Santan (Pork in Coconut, no blood)
Saksang Santan (Babi Bersantan, tanpa darah)
description: Spicy Batak pork stew with andaliman-style spices, made with coconut milk instead of pork blood. Good in the multi-cooker.
Saksang babi pedas khas Batak dengan bumbu ala andaliman, memakai santan sebagai pengganti darah babi. Cocok dimasak di multi-cooker.
equipment: Lauben multi-cooker 18SB or a pot on the gas stove
Multi-cooker Lauben 18SB atau panci di kompor gas

name: pork shoulder (vepřová plec) or pork belly (bůček), 3 cm cubes
daging bahu babi (vepřová plec) atau samcan (bůček), potong dadu 3 cm
galangal (or 1 tsp powder), for the paste
lengkuas (atau 1 sdt bubuk), untuk bumbu halus
Sichuan pepper, toasted, for the paste
lada Sichuan, disangrai, untuk bumbu halus
red chilies (or 1-2 tbsp sambal oelek), for the paste
cabai merah (atau 1-2 sdm sambal oelek), untuk bumbu halus
bay leaves (bobkový list, instead of salam)
daun salam Eropa (bobkový list, pengganti daun salam)

title: Paste
Bumbu halus
text: Toast the Sichuan pepper briefly, then blitz all paste ingredients in the chopper.
Sangrai lada Sichuan sebentar, lalu haluskan semua bahan bumbu di chopper.

title: Brown
Tumis daging
text: Brown the pork in the oil, in a pan or using the multi-cooker's frying/sauté program, until lightly coloured.
Tumis daging babi dengan minyak, di wajan atau dengan program goreng/tumis di multi-cooker, sampai agak kecokelatan.

title: Fry the paste
Tumis bumbu
text: Add the paste and fry for 5 minutes, stirring, until fragrant and the oil separates a little.
Masukkan bumbu halus dan tumis 5 menit sambil diaduk, sampai harum dan minyaknya sedikit keluar.

title: Stew
Masak lama
text: Add lemongrass, lime leaves, bay leaves, water, salt and sugar. Pot: cover and simmer on low for about 60 minutes. Multi-cooker: use the stew/slow-cook program; check your manual for the time setting (meat should end up fork-tender).

Masukkan serai, daun jeruk, daun salam, air, garam, dan gula. Panci: tutup dan masak dengan api kecil sekitar 60 menit. Multi-cooker: pakai program stew/slow cook; cek buku manual untuk pengaturan waktunya (daging harus sampai empuk).

title: Coconut
Santan
text: Add the coconut milk and cook uncovered for 10-15 minutes more, stirring, until the sauce thickens. Taste and adjust salt and chili. Serve with rice.
Masukkan santan dan masak tanpa tutup 10-15 menit lagi sambil diaduk, sampai kuahnya mengental. Cicipi lalu sesuaikan garam dan cabainya. Sajikan dengan nasi.

notes: Traditional saksang uses pork blood; the coconut milk version is a common alternative.
Saksang tradisional memakai darah babi; versi santan adalah alternatif yang umum.
Tastes even better the next day.
Rasanya lebih enak lagi keesokan harinya.
Works with chicken thighs too; cut the stewing time to about 30 minutes.
Bisa juga pakai paha ayam; kurangi waktu masak jadi sekitar 30 menit.

items: Sichuan pepper, galangal, lemongrass, lime leaves
lada Sichuan, lengkuas, serai, daun jeruk
pork, coconut milk, shallots, macadamia, bay leaves
daging babi, santan, bawang merah, macadamia, daun salam Eropa

title: Mie Gomak Goreng (with spaghetti)
Mie Gomak Goreng (pakai spaghetti)
description: Batak fried noodles made with thick spaghetti instead of mie lidi, with a turmeric and Sichuan-pepper paste. Quick weeknight dish.
Mie gomak goreng khas Batak dengan spaghetti tebal sebagai pengganti mie lidi, dengan bumbu kunyit dan lada Sichuan. Cepat untuk makan malam sehari-hari.

name: Sichuan pepper, toasted, for the paste
lada Sichuan, disangrai, untuk bumbu halus
chicken or pork, thin strips (optional)
daging ayam atau babi, iris tipis (opsional)

title: Pasta
Pasta
text: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until just al dente. Drain and toss with a few drops of oil.
Rebus spaghetti di air bergaram sampai al dente. Tiriskan dan aduk dengan sedikit minyak.

title: Paste
Bumbu halus
text: Blitz the paste ingredients in the chopper.
Haluskan bahan bumbu di chopper.

title: Fry
Goreng
text: Fry the paste in the oil for 3-4 minutes. Add the meat and cook through.
Tumis bumbu halus dengan minyak selama 3-4 menit. Masukkan daging dan masak sampai matang.

title: Egg and cabbage
Telur dan kol
text: Push everything aside, scramble the egg in the gap, then add the cabbage and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Sisihkan semuanya ke pinggir, orak-arik telur di tengah, lalu masukkan kol dan tumis 2 menit.

title: Toss
Aduk
text: Add the spaghetti, kecap manis and soy sauce. Toss on high heat for 2 minutes. Finish with spring onions.
Masukkan spaghetti, kecap manis, dan kecap asin. Aduk di api besar selama 2 menit. Taburi daun bawang.

notes: Thick spaghetti (No. 7 or thicker) is the closest to mie lidi.
Spaghetti tebal (No. 7 atau lebih tebal) paling mirip mie lidi.
For mie gomak kuah (soup), add 500 ml chicken stock and 100 ml coconut milk after frying the paste, then add the pasta.
Untuk mie gomak kuah, tambahkan 500 ml kaldu ayam dan 100 ml santan setelah menumis bumbu, lalu masukkan pasta.

where: Asian grocery shops; kecap manis is also in some big supermarkets
Toko Asia; kecap manis juga ada di beberapa supermarket besar

title: Daun Ubi Tumbuk (Greens in Coconut)
Daun Ubi Tumbuk (Sayur Bersantan)
description: Batak pounded cassava leaves in coconut milk. The chopper does the pounding. Uses frozen cassava leaves, or kale/spinach as a substitute.
Daun singkong tumbuk khas Batak dengan santan. Chopper menggantikan proses menumbuk. Memakai daun singkong beku, atau kale/bayam sebagai pengganti.

name: frozen cassava leaves, thawed, or 400 g kale (kadeřávek) without stems
daun singkong beku, dicairkan, atau 400 g kale (kadeřávek) tanpa batang
Sichuan pepper, toasted, for the paste
lada Sichuan, disangrai, untuk bumbu halus

title: Chop the leaves
Cincang daun
text: Pulse the leaves in the chopper in batches until finely chopped. This replaces pounding.
Cincang daun di chopper sedikit demi sedikit sampai halus. Ini pengganti menumbuk.

title: Paste
Bumbu halus
text: Blitz the paste ingredients in the chopper.
Haluskan bahan bumbu di chopper.

title: Cook the leaves
Rebus daun
text: Simmer the leaves in the water with the lemongrass. Cassava leaves: at least 20 minutes, until soft. Kale: about 8 minutes.
Rebus daun dengan air dan serai. Daun singkong: minimal 20 menit, sampai empuk. Kale: sekitar 8 menit.

title: Coconut
Santan
text: Add the paste, coconut milk, salt, sugar and anchovies. Simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Masukkan bumbu halus, santan, garam, gula, dan teri. Masak tanpa tutup 15-20 menit, sering diaduk, sampai kental.

notes: Cassava leaves must be cooked thoroughly; never eat them raw or undercooked.
Daun singkong harus dimasak sampai benar-benar matang; jangan dimakan mentah atau setengah matang.
Kale gives the closest texture; spinach works but cooks down a lot and is softer.
Kale paling mirip teksturnya; bayam juga bisa tapi menyusut banyak dan lebih lembek.

where: some Asian or African grocery shops (check the freezer section)
beberapa toko Asia atau Afrika (cek bagian frozen)

items: lengkuas, lada Sichuan, ikan teri kering

title: Ayam Panggang Andaliman (Oven Chicken)
Ayam Panggang Andaliman (Ayam Oven)
description: Simplified ayam napinadar: oven-roasted turmeric chicken thighs tossed in a fresh Sichuan-pepper sambal. No blood sauce.
Ayam napinadar versi sederhana: paha ayam bumbu kunyit dipanggang di oven, lalu diaduk dengan sambal lada Sichuan segar. Tanpa saus darah.
time: 15 min prep + 30 min marinate + 40 min roast
15 menit persiapan + 30 menit marinasi + 40 menit panggang

title: Marinate
Marinasi
text: Rub the chicken with turmeric, garlic, lime juice, salt and oil. Leave at least 30 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Lumuri ayam dengan kunyit, bawang putih, air jeruk nipis, garam, dan minyak. Diamkan minimal 30 menit (atau semalaman di kulkas).

title: Roast
Panggang
text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast skin side up for 35-40 minutes until golden and the juices run clear. In a glass dish, use 190°C and allow a few extra minutes.
Panaskan oven 200°C. Panggang dengan sisi kulit di atas selama 35-40 menit sampai keemasan dan cairannya bening. Di pinggan kaca, pakai 190°C dan tambah beberapa menit.

title: Sambal
Sambal
text: Meanwhile make the Sambal Andaliman.
Sementara itu, buat Sambal Andaliman.

title: Toss
Aduk
text: Toss the hot chicken with half the sambal and serve the rest on the side, with rice.
Aduk ayam panas dengan setengah sambal, sisanya disajikan terpisah, dengan nasi.

notes: Traditional napinadar uses a sauce thickened with chicken blood; this version leaves it out.
Napinadar tradisional memakai saus yang dikentalkan dengan darah ayam; versi ini tanpa darah.
Can also be pan-grilled on the gas stove: about 8-10 minutes per side on medium heat.
Bisa juga dipanggang di wajan grill di kompor gas: sekitar 8-10 menit per sisi dengan api sedang.

title: Sambal Andaliman (Sichuan pepper sambal)
Sambal Andaliman (sambal lada Sichuan)
description: Fresh Batak sambal with the tingly citrus kick of andaliman, using Sichuan pepper. Made in the chopper.
Sambal segar khas Batak dengan rasa getir-segar andaliman, memakai lada Sichuan. Dibuat di chopper.

name: red chilies (or 5 chilies + ½ red bell pepper for milder)
cabai merah (atau 5 cabai + ½ paprika merah supaya tidak terlalu pedas)

title: Toast
Sangrai
text: Toast the Sichuan pepper in a dry pan for about 1 minute until fragrant. Let it cool.
Sangrai lada Sichuan di wajan kering sekitar 1 menit sampai harum. Biarkan dingin.

title: Chop
Cincang
text: Pulse everything except the lime juice in the chopper to a coarse sambal. Don't make it a smooth purée.
Cincang semua bahan kecuali air jeruk nipis di chopper sampai jadi sambal kasar. Jangan sampai halus seperti pure.

title: Season
Bumbui
text: Stir in the lime juice and salt to taste.
Aduk air jeruk nipis dan garam secukupnya.

notes: Keeps 3-4 days in a closed jar in the fridge.
Tahan 3-4 hari di toples tertutup dalam kulkas.
Use it with grilled fish, chicken, eggs, or as a side for any of the Batak dishes here.
Cocok dengan ikan bakar, ayam, telur, atau sebagai pendamping semua masakan Batak di sini.

items: cabai merah, bawang merah, bawang putih, jeruk nipis

title: BPK (Babi Panggang Karo)
BPK (Babi Panggang Karo)
description: Karo-style roast pork, sliced thin and served with a spicy andaliman sauce, rice and greens soup. Simplified: oven or grill pan instead of charcoal, and a blood-free sauce.
Babi panggang ala Karo, diiris tipis dan disajikan dengan saus andaliman pedas, nasi, dan sop daun. Versi sederhana: oven atau wajan grill sebagai pengganti arang, dan saus tanpa darah.
time: 15 min prep + 1 h marinate + 40 min roast
15 menit persiapan + 1 jam marinasi + 40 menit panggang
oven: 220°C top & bottom heat (or fan 200°C), then grill 3-5 min
220°C api atas & bawah (atau kipas 200°C), lalu grill 3-5 menit
equipment: wall oven (or grill pan on the gas stove)
oven tanam (atau wajan grill di kompor gas)

name: pork neck (krkovice) or pork belly (bůček), slices 2-3 cm thick
daging leher babi (krkovice) atau samcan (bůček), iris setebal 2-3 cm
garlic cloves, grated, for the marinade
bawang putih, diparut, untuk marinasi
Sichuan pepper, toasted and ground, for the marinade
lada Sichuan, disangrai dan dihaluskan, untuk marinasi
Sichuan pepper, toasted, for the sauce
lada Sichuan, disangrai, untuk saus

title: Marinate
Marinasi
text: Mix garlic, ginger, ground Sichuan pepper, black pepper, salt and oil. Rub into the pork. Marinate at least 1 hour, or overnight in the fridge.
Campur bawang putih, jahe, lada Sichuan halus, lada hitam, garam, dan minyak. Lumurkan ke daging babi. Marinasi minimal 1 jam, atau semalaman di kulkas.

title: Roast
Panggang
text: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the pork on a rack over a tray (add a little water to the tray so the drippings don't burn). Roast 30-40 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and browned.
Panaskan oven 220°C. Taruh daging di rak di atas loyang (beri sedikit air di loyang supaya tetesan lemak tidak gosong). Panggang 30-40 menit, balik sekali, sampai matang dan kecokelatan.

title: Char
Bakar
text: Switch to the grill (top heat) for 3-5 minutes to get charred edges. Watch closely. Stovetop option: grill pan on medium-high, 5-7 minutes per side.
Pindah ke mode grill (api atas) selama 3-5 menit supaya pinggirannya gosong sedikit. Awasi terus. Pilihan kompor: wajan grill di api sedang-besar, 5-7 menit per sisi.

title: Sauce
Saus
text: Blitz the sauce ingredients (shallots, garlic, Sichuan pepper, chilies, macadamia) in the chopper. Fry in oil for 3-4 minutes, add the tray drippings, water and kecap manis, and simmer 5 minutes until slightly thick. Finish with lime juice and salt to taste.

Haluskan bahan saus (bawang merah, bawang putih, lada Sichuan, cabai, macadamia) di chopper. Tumis dengan minyak 3-4 menit, masukkan tetesan dari loyang, air, dan kecap manis, lalu masak 5 menit sampai agak kental. Beri air jeruk nipis dan garam secukupnya.

title: Serve
Sajikan
text: Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice thin, and serve with the sauce, Sambal Andaliman, rice and a bowl of greens soup.
Diamkan daging 5 menit, iris tipis, dan sajikan dengan saus, Sambal Andaliman, nasi, dan semangkuk sop daun.

notes: Traditional BPK sauce is made with pork blood; this version uses the roasting juices instead.
Saus BPK tradisional dibuat dengan darah babi; versi ini memakai cairan dari panggangan.
Krkovice (pork neck) stays juicy and is the easiest cut; bůček gives more fat and crisp edges.
Krkovice (leher babi) tetap juicy dan paling mudah; bůček lebih berlemak dan pinggirannya renyah.
BPK is usually served with a light cassava-leaf soup: make Daun Ubi Tumbuk with extra water and less coconut milk.
BPK biasanya disajikan dengan sop daun singkong yang ringan: buat Daun Ubi Tumbuk dengan air lebih banyak dan santan lebih sedikit.

items: pork (bůček, krkovice), shallots, garlic, ginger, limes
daging babi (bůček, krkovice), bawang merah, bawang putih, jahe, jeruk nipis

title: Babi Panggang Batak (Toba-style, crispy skin)
Babi Panggang Batak (ala Toba, kulit renyah)
description: Slow-roasted pork belly with crispy skin, the meat side rubbed with a turmeric and andaliman paste. Served with fresh sambal andaliman.
Samcan dipanggang perlahan dengan kulit renyah, sisi dagingnya dilumuri bumbu kunyit dan andaliman. Disajikan dengan sambal andaliman segar.
time: 15 min prep + overnight drying (optional) + 1 h 50 min roast
15 menit persiapan + dikeringkan semalaman (opsional) + 1 jam 50 menit panggang
oven: 160°C top & bottom heat, then 230°C to crisp the skin
160°C api atas & bawah, lalu 230°C untuk merenyahkan kulit

name: pork belly with skin (bůček s kůží), one slab
samcan dengan kulit (bůček s kůží), satu lembar utuh
galangal or ginger, for the paste
lengkuas atau jahe, untuk bumbu halus
Sichuan pepper, toasted, for the paste
lada Sichuan, disangrai, untuk bumbu halus

title: Dry the skin
Keringkan kulit
text: Pat the skin very dry and score it in a fine grid with a sharp knife (cut the skin and fat, not the meat). For the crispiest skin, leave it uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Tepuk-tepuk kulit sampai benar-benar kering dan sayat kotak-kotak kecil dengan pisau tajam (sayat kulit dan lemaknya, jangan dagingnya). Supaya paling renyah, simpan tanpa tutup di kulkas semalaman.

title: Paste
Bumbu halus
text: Blitz the paste ingredients in the chopper. Rub it only on the meat side and edges. Keep the skin clean and dry.
Haluskan bahan bumbu di chopper. Lumurkan hanya ke sisi daging dan pinggirannya. Jaga kulit tetap bersih dan kering.

title: Salt the skin
Garami kulit
text: Rub 2 tsp salt into the scored skin. Place skin side up on a rack over a tray with a little water in it.
Gosokkan 2 sdt garam ke kulit yang sudah disayat. Taruh dengan kulit di atas, di rak di atas loyang berisi sedikit air.

title: Slow roast
Panggang perlahan
text: Roast at 160°C, top and bottom heat, for 1.5 hours.
Panggang di 160°C, api atas dan bawah, selama 1,5 jam.

title: Crisp
Renyahkan
text: Brush off excess salt, raise the heat to 230°C (or use the grill) and roast 15-25 minutes until the skin puffs and crackles. Watch closely so it doesn't burn.
Sikat sisa garam, naikkan suhu ke 230°C (atau pakai grill) dan panggang 15-25 menit sampai kulit menggelembung dan renyah. Awasi terus supaya tidak gosong.

title: Serve
Sajikan
text: Rest 10 minutes, cut into bite-size pieces with a heavy knife, and serve with Sambal Andaliman and rice.
Diamkan 10 menit, potong seukuran gigitan dengan pisau besar, lalu sajikan dengan Sambal Andaliman dan nasi.

notes: Dry skin is the key to crackling: the drier, the crispier.
Kulit yang kering adalah kunci kerenyahan: makin kering, makin renyah.
If parts of the skin don't puff, put those pieces under the grill for a few minutes.
Kalau ada bagian kulit yang tidak menggelembung, taruh potongan itu di bawah grill beberapa menit.
Ask the butcher for 'bůček s kůží' in one piece; supermarkets often sell it pre-packed.
Minta 'bůček s kůží' satu potong utuh ke tukang daging; supermarket juga sering menjualnya dalam kemasan.

items: pork belly with skin, shallots, garlic, turmeric
samcan dengan kulit, bawang merah, bawang putih, kunyit

title: Babi Goreng Batak
Babi Goreng Batak
description: Pork belly first simmered until tender, then fried until golden and crisp, eaten with sambal andaliman and rice. Simple and very forgiving.
Samcan direbus dulu sampai empuk, lalu digoreng sampai keemasan dan renyah, dimakan dengan sambal andaliman dan nasi. Sederhana dan sulit gagal.
time: 10 min prep + 30 min simmer + 15 min fry
10 menit persiapan + 30 menit rebus + 15 menit goreng
equipment: Lauben multi-cooker 18SB or a pot (for simmering)

title: Simmer
Masak perlahan
text: Simmer the pork with water, salt, garlic, ginger and bay leaves for 30 minutes until tender. Multi-cooker: use the stew or soup program; check your manual for the time.
Rebus daging babi dengan air, garam, bawang putih, jahe, dan daun salam selama 30 menit sampai empuk. Multi-cooker: pakai program stew atau sup; cek buku manual untuk waktunya.

title: Dry
Keringkan
text: Drain well and pat the pieces dry with kitchen paper. Dry pork fries crisp; wet pork splatters.
Tiriskan dan keringkan potongan daging dengan tisu dapur. Daging kering jadi renyah; daging basah memercik minyak.

title: Season
Bumbui
text: Toss with salt, turmeric and ground Sichuan pepper.
Aduk dengan garam, kunyit, dan lada Sichuan halus.

title: Fry
Goreng
text: Heat the oil in a pan on medium-high. Fry the pork in one layer, turning now and then, for 10-15 minutes until golden and crisp. Use a lid or splatter screen.
Panaskan minyak di wajan dengan api sedang-besar. Goreng daging dalam satu lapis, sesekali dibalik, selama 10-15 menit sampai keemasan dan renyah. Pakai tutup atau saringan anti-percikan.

title: Serve
Sajikan
text: Sprinkle with fried shallots and serve with Sambal Andaliman and rice.
Taburi bawang goreng dan sajikan dengan Sambal Andaliman dan nasi.

notes: Keep the simmering broth: with some greens and andaliman it makes a good soup.
Simpan air rebusannya: ditambah sayur dan andaliman jadi sup yang enak.
For extra crunch, toss the dried pieces in 2 tbsp cornstarch (kukuřičný škrob / Solamyl) before frying.
Supaya lebih renyah, balur potongan yang sudah kering dengan 2 sdm maizena (kukuřičný škrob / Solamyl) sebelum digoreng.

title: Versatile Peanut Sauce (Bumbu Kacang)
Bumbu Kacang Serbaguna
description: A simple peanut sauce for gado-gado style salad, fried tofu/tempeh, or as a satay dipping sauce — adjust the water to make it thinner or thicker.
Bumbu kacang sederhana untuk salad gado-gado, tahu/tempe goreng, atau cocolan sate — atur air untuk kekentalan sesuai kebutuhan.

name: roasted peanuts (unsalted), or smooth peanut butter
kacang tanah goreng tanpa garam, atau selai kacang halus
tamarind juice or lime juice
air asam jawa atau air jeruk nipis
warm water, to thin (adjust as needed)
air hangat, untuk mengencerkan (sesuaikan)

title: Grind the peanuts
Haluskan kacang
text: If using whole roasted peanuts, blend or chop until mostly smooth (a little texture is fine). Skip this step if using peanut butter.
Jika memakai kacang tanah utuh, haluskan dengan blender atau chopper sampai cukup halus (sedikit tekstur tidak masalah). Lewati langkah ini jika memakai selai kacang.

title: Blend the aromatics
Haluskan bumbu
text: Blend the garlic, shallot and chili (if using) into a smooth paste.
Haluskan bawang putih, bawang merah, dan cabai (jika pakai) sampai menjadi pasta halus.

title: Combine and warm
Campur dan panaskan
text: In a small pan, warm the paste with 2-3 tbsp water for a minute, then stir in the ground peanuts, sugar, tamarind/lime juice and salt.
Dalam panci kecil, panaskan pasta bumbu dengan 2-3 sdm air selama satu menit, lalu masukkan kacang halus, gula, air asam/jeruk nipis, dan garam.

title: Thin to taste
Encerkan sesuai kebutuhan
text: Add warm water a little at a time, stirring, until pourable for a salad dressing or thicker for a dip. Taste and adjust sugar/salt/sour.
Tambahkan air hangat sedikit demi sedikit sambil diaduk, sampai cukup cair untuk saus salad atau lebih kental untuk cocolan. Cicipi, sesuaikan gula/garam/asam.

notes: For gado-gado or lotek: thin it more so it coats vegetables easily.
Untuk gado-gado atau lotek: encerkan lebih supaya mudah melapisi sayuran.
For fried tofu/tempeh or satay: keep it thicker, almost like a dip.
Untuk tahu/tempe goreng atau sate: buat lebih kental, hampir seperti cocolan.
Keeps in the fridge about a week in a sealed jar; it thickens when cold, loosen with a splash of warm water before serving.
Tahan di kulkas sekitar satu minggu dalam toples tertutup; akan mengental saat dingin, encerkan lagi dengan sedikit air hangat sebelum disajikan.

title: Homemade Tempeh (Soybean)
Tempe Rumahan (Kedelai)
description: Fermented soybean cake made from scratch with tempeh starter (ragi tempe) — needs a warm spot and 24-48 hours, but very little hands-on work.
Kedelai yang difermentasi dari awal dengan ragi tempe — butuh tempat hangat dan 24-48 jam, tapi kerja tangannya sedikit.
equipment: perforated plastic bags or banana leaves
a warm spot around 30°C (oven with the light on, or near a radiator)
tempat hangat sekitar 30°C (oven dengan lampu menyala, atau dekat radiator)

name: tempeh starter (ragi tempe, Rhizopus culture) — follow your packet's dose
ragi tempe (ragi Rhizopus) — ikuti dosis pada kemasan

title: Soak and split
Rendam dan belah
text: Rinse the soybeans, then soak in plenty of water for 8-12 hours (overnight) until they split into halves easily.
Cuci kedelai, lalu rendam dalam banyak air selama 8-12 jam (semalaman) sampai mudah terbelah dua.

title: Dehull and boil
Kupas kulit dan rebus
text: Rub the soaked beans between your hands (or pulse briefly in a blender with water) to loosen the thin yellow skins, then rinse the skins away. Boil the dehulled beans 30-45 minutes until tender.

Gosok kedelai yang sudah direndam di antara telapak tangan (atau blender sebentar dengan air) untuk melepas kulit kuning tipisnya, lalu bilas kulitnya. Rebus kedelai yang sudah dikupas 30-45 menit sampai empuk.

title: Drain and dry
Tiriskan dan keringkan
text: Drain very well and spread on a clean towel until dry to the touch and no longer steaming — damp beans will spoil the ferment.
Tiriskan dengan baik dan hamparkan di atas lap bersih sampai kering saat disentuh dan tidak lagi berasap — kedelai yang masih lembap akan merusak fermentasi.

title: Mix in the starter
Campur ragi
text: Once just warm (not hot), sprinkle the tempeh starter over the beans per the dose on your packet, and mix thoroughly so every bean is coated.
Setelah hangat (bukan panas), taburkan ragi tempe sesuai dosis pada kemasan, lalu campur rata sampai setiap biji kedelai terlapisi.

title: Pack and perforate
Kemas dan lubangi
text: Pack the beans into perforated plastic bags or wrap in banana leaves, about 2cm thick, and poke small holes every few centimetres for airflow.
Masukkan kedelai ke plastik berlubang atau bungkus daun pisang, tebal sekitar 2cm, lalu tusuk lubang-lubang kecil setiap beberapa sentimeter untuk sirkulasi udara.

title: Ferment
Fermentasi
text: Leave in a warm spot (around 30°C) for 24-48 hours. It's ready when the beans are bound by a firm white mycelium and the cake holds its shape when sliced; a faint ammonia smell is normal, a strong rotten smell or dark patches means it's spoiled.

Diamkan di tempat hangat (sekitar 30°C) selama 24-48 jam. Tempe siap saat kedelai terikat oleh miselium putih yang padat dan bisa diiris rapi; bau amonia samar itu normal, tapi bau busuk menyengat atau bercak gelap berarti gagal.

notes: Tempeh starter isn't sold in regular Prague supermarkets — order online (search “ragi tempe” or “tempeh starter culture”) or check Asian grocery shops; it keeps for months in the freezer.
Ragi tempe tidak dijual di supermarket biasa di Praha — pesan online (cari “ragi tempe” atau “tempeh starter culture”) atau cek toko Asia; tahan berbulan-bulan di freezer.
No perforated bags? A regular freezer bag poked with a fork every 2-3cm works fine.
Tidak ada plastik berlubang? Kantong freezer biasa yang ditusuk garpu setiap 2-3cm juga bisa.
Once fermented, keep in the fridge up to a week, or slice and freeze for longer.
Setelah jadi, simpan di kulkas sampai satu minggu, atau iris dan simpan di freezer untuk lebih lama.

where: Asian shops, or online for the starter
toko Asia, atau online untuk raginya

title: Homemade Bean Sprouts (Tauge)
Tauge Rumahan
description: Crunchy fresh bean sprouts from mung beans (or soybeans) with no special equipment — just rinsing twice a day for a few days.
Tauge segar dan renyah dari kacang hijau (atau kedelai) tanpa alat khusus — cukup dibilas dua kali sehari selama beberapa hari.
time: 5 min a day active + 2-4 days sprouting
5 menit per hari kerja aktif + 2-4 hari penyemaian
equipment: a dark cupboard or covered container

name: water, for soaking and rinsing (fresh water each time)
air, untuk merendam dan membilas (air baru setiap kali)

title: Soak overnight
Rendam semalaman
text: Rinse the beans, then soak in plenty of water for 8-12 hours.
Cuci kacang, lalu rendam dalam banyak air selama 8-12 jam.

title: Rest in the dark
Simpan di tempat gelap
text: Drain well and spread the beans in a jar or bowl lined with a damp cloth, no more than 3-4cm deep. Cover loosely (a cloth, or a lid with holes) and keep somewhere dark and warm.

Tiriskan dengan baik dan hamparkan kacang dalam toples atau mangkuk yang dilapisi kain lembap, tidak lebih dari 3-4cm tebalnya. Tutup longgar (kain, atau penutup berlubang) dan simpan di tempat gelap dan hangat.

title: Rinse twice a day
Bilas dua kali sehari
text: Every morning and evening, rinse the beans with fresh water and drain thoroughly — this keeps them from rotting and washes away the heat they generate as they grow.
Setiap pagi dan sore, bilas kacang dengan air bersih dan tiriskan sampai benar-benar kering — ini mencegah pembusukan dan membuang panas yang dihasilkan saat tumbuh.

title: Harvest
Panen
text: After 2-3 days (mung beans) or 3-4 days (soybeans) the sprouts are ready, with a short white-yellow shoot. Rinse once more, drain, and use within 2-3 days in the fridge.
Setelah 2-3 hari (kacang hijau) atau 3-4 hari (kedelai) tauge siap, dengan kecambah putih-kuning pendek. Bilas sekali lagi, tiriskan, dan gunakan dalam 2-3 hari di kulkas.

notes: Keeping them in the dark gives the pale, crunchy sprouts you see in shops; in light they turn greener and slightly more bitter — both are fine to eat.
Menyimpan di tempat gelap menghasilkan tauge pucat dan renyah seperti yang dijual di toko; kalau terkena cahaya akan lebih hijau dan agak pahit — keduanya tetap aman dimakan.
If they smell sour or feel slimy, rinse more often (3x a day) or discard and start again — that's over-fermentation, not normal.
Kalau berbau asam atau berlendir, bilas lebih sering (3x sehari) atau buang dan ulangi dari awal — itu tanda fermentasi berlebihan, bukan hal normal.

title: Kopi Tubruk
Kopi Tubruk
description: Traditional Indonesian boiled coffee: finely ground coffee and sugar steeped directly in hot water, unfiltered — the grounds settle at the bottom.
Kopi tradisional Indonesia: kopi giling halus dan gula diseduh langsung dengan air panas, tanpa disaring — ampasnya mengendap di dasar gelas.

name: finely ground coffee (robusta for the traditional taste, if you can find it)
kopi giling halus (robusta untuk rasa tradisional, kalau ada)

title: Add coffee and sugar
Masukkan kopi dan gula
text: Put the ground coffee and sugar directly into a sturdy cup or glass.
Masukkan kopi giling dan gula langsung ke gelas atau cangkir yang kokoh.

title: Pour and stir
Tuang dan aduk
text: Pour the just-boiled water over it and stir well.
Tuang air yang baru mendidih di atasnya dan aduk rata.

title: Let it settle
Diamkan
text: Let it sit 1-2 minutes so the grounds sink to the bottom before drinking — sip from the top, don't stir again near the end.
Diamkan 1-2 menit sampai ampas mengendap di dasar sebelum diminum — seruput dari atas, jangan diaduk lagi menjelang habis.

notes: Traditionally made with robusta for a stronger, more bitter cup; arabica works too but tastes milder.
Biasanya memakai robusta untuk rasa yang lebih kuat dan pahit; arabica juga bisa, rasanya lebih ringan.

title: Es Kopi Susu
Es Kopi Susu
description: Indonesian iced coffee with sweetened condensed milk (or palm sugar syrup) — sweeter and creamier than a Western iced latte.
Kopi dingin khas Indonesia dengan susu kental manis (atau sirop gula aren) — lebih manis dan creamy dibanding iced latte ala Barat.

name: strong brewed coffee (kopi tubruk or strong filter coffee), cooled
kopi pekat yang sudah diseduh (kopi tubruk atau filter kuat), didinginkan
sweetened condensed milk, or 2 tbsp palm sugar syrup
susu kental manis, atau 2 sdm sirop gula aren

title: Brew and cool the coffee
Seduh dan dinginkan kopi
text: Make a strong batch of coffee (see Kopi Tubruk, just extra strong) and let it cool to room temperature, or chill it.
Buat kopi pekat (lihat Kopi Tubruk, tapi dibuat lebih kuat) dan biarkan dingin sampai suhu ruang, atau simpan di kulkas.

title: Fill the glass with ice
Isi gelas dengan es
text: Fill a glass with ice cubes.
Isi gelas dengan es batu.

title: Add milk and coffee
Tambahkan susu dan kopi
text: Pour in the condensed milk or palm sugar syrup, then pour the coffee on top. Stir well before drinking.
Tuang susu kental manis atau sirop gula aren, lalu tuang kopi di atasnya. Aduk rata sebelum diminum.

notes: No condensed milk? Mix 2 tbsp sugar with 1 tbsp hot water for a quick syrup, then add a splash of regular milk or cream separately.
Tidak ada susu kental manis? Campur 2 sdm gula dengan 1 sdm air panas untuk sirop cepat, lalu tambahkan sedikit susu cair atau krim secara terpisah.

title: Sweet Iced Tea (Es Teh Manis)
Es Teh Manis
description: Indonesia's everyday drink: strong black tea sweetened while hot, then served over ice.
Minuman sehari-hari di Indonesia: teh hitam pekat yang dimaniskan saat masih panas, lalu disajikan dengan es.

name: black tea bag, or 1 tsp loose black tea
kantong teh hitam, atau 1 sdt teh hitam curah

title: Steep strong
Seduh pekat
text: Steep the tea bag or loose tea in the just-boiled water for 4-5 minutes — stronger than for a hot cup, since it'll be diluted by the ice.
Seduh kantong teh atau teh curah dalam air mendidih selama 4-5 menit — lebih pekat dari biasanya untuk teh panas, karena nanti akan terkena es.

title: Sweeten while hot
Maniskan saat masih panas
text: Remove the tea bag/leaves and stir in the sugar while the tea is still hot, so it dissolves completely.
Angkat kantong teh/ampasnya dan aduk gula saat teh masih panas, supaya larut sempurna.

title: Pour over ice
Tuang di atas es
text: Fill a glass with ice and pour the sweetened tea over it.
Isi gelas dengan es dan tuang teh manis di atasnya.

notes: Start with 2 tbsp sugar and adjust — some warungs make it sweeter still.
Mulai dengan 2 sdm gula dan sesuaikan — beberapa warung membuatnya lebih manis lagi.

title: Ginger Tea (Wedang Jahe)
Wedang Jahe
description: A warming, spiced ginger drink — good for cold weather or an upset stomach.
Minuman jahe hangat berbumbu — enak untuk cuaca dingin atau perut kurang nyaman.

name: fresh ginger, sliced and lightly crushed
jahe segar, iris dan memarkan
pandan leaf, tied in a knot, optional
daun pandan, diikat simpul, opsional

title: Simmer the ginger
Rebus jahe
text: Bring the water to a boil with the crushed ginger (and cinnamon/pandan if using), then lower the heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Didihkan air bersama jahe yang dimemarkan (dan kayu manis/daun pandan jika pakai), lalu kecilkan api dan rebus selama 10 menit.

title: Sweeten and strain
Maniskan dan saring
text: Stir in the sugar until dissolved, then strain into a cup.
Aduk gula sampai larut, lalu saring ke dalam cangkir.

notes: Crushing (not just slicing) the ginger releases more flavour — smash it lightly with the back of a knife or a pestle.
Memarkan (bukan sekadar mengiris) jahe mengeluarkan rasa lebih kuat — pukul perlahan dengan punggung pisau atau alu.

title: Spiced Ginger Coconut Drink (Bandrek)
Bandrek
description: A rich, spiced ginger drink from West Java, often with coconut milk and whole spices — stronger and more warming than wedang jahe.
Minuman jahe berempah dari Jawa Barat, biasanya dengan santan dan rempah utuh — lebih kuat dan menghangatkan dibanding wedang jahe.

name: coconut milk, optional, for a creamier version
santan, opsional, untuk versi lebih creamy

title: Simmer ginger and spices
Rebus jahe dan rempah
text: Boil the water with the ginger, cloves, cinnamon and peppercorns, then simmer 15 minutes until fragrant and slightly reduced.
Didihkan air bersama jahe, cengkih, kayu manis, dan lada, lalu rebus selama 15 menit sampai harum dan sedikit menyusut.

title: Add sugar and coconut milk
Tambahkan gula dan santan
text: Stir in the palm sugar until dissolved. If using coconut milk, add it now and warm through without boiling hard (to avoid curdling).
Aduk gula aren sampai larut. Jika memakai santan, masukkan sekarang dan panaskan tanpa mendidih keras (agar tidak pecah).

title: Strain and serve hot
Saring dan sajikan hangat
text: Strain out the whole spices and ginger, and serve hot.
Saring rempah utuh dan jahe, lalu sajikan hangat.

notes: Traditionally served with a little toasted coconut or bread on the side — skip these if not available in Prague.
Biasanya disajikan dengan sedikit kelapa parut sangrai atau roti sebagai pelengkap — boleh dilewati jika tidak tersedia di Praha.

title: Es Cendol
Es Cendol
description: A dessert drink of chewy green rice-flour noodles (cendol) in coconut milk and palm sugar syrup, over ice — the Prague version uses food colouring since pandan extract is hard to find.
Minuman dessert berisi cendol (mi dari tepung beras berwarna hijau, kenyal) dalam santan dan sirop gula aren, dengan es — versi Praha memakai pewarna makanan karena ekstrak pandan sulit ditemukan.
equipment: piping bag, or a bottle with holes poked in the cap
plastik segitiga, atau botol yang tutupnya dilubangi

name: drops green food colouring (stands in for pandan)
tetes pewarna hijau (pengganti pandan)
palm sugar, melted with 3 tbsp water into a syrup
gula aren, dilelehkan dengan 3 sdm air menjadi sirop

title: Make the batter
Buat adonan
text: Whisk the rice flour, tapioca starch, water and food colouring together in a pan until smooth.
Aduk rata tepung beras, tepung tapioka, air, dan pewarna makanan dalam panci sampai halus.

title: Cook until thick
Masak sampai mengental
text: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens into a smooth, pipeable paste (a few minutes).
Masak dengan api sedang, aduk terus, sampai mengental menjadi pasta yang halus dan bisa dicetak (beberapa menit).

title: Shape into strands
Bentuk menjadi untaian
text: While still hot, pipe or push the batter through small holes directly into the bowl of ice water, so it forms short noodle-like strands that firm up immediately.
Selagi masih panas, cetak adonan melalui lubang kecil langsung ke mangkuk air es, sehingga membentuk untaian seperti mi pendek yang langsung mengeras.

title: Warm the coconut milk
Panaskan santan
text: Gently warm the coconut milk with the salt (don't boil hard), then let it cool.
Panaskan santan perlahan dengan garam (jangan sampai mendidih keras), lalu biarkan dingin.

title: Assemble
Rangkai
text: Drain the cendol strands. In a glass, layer ice, cendol, coconut milk and palm sugar syrup. Stir before drinking.
Tiriskan untaian cendol. Dalam gelas, tata es, cendol, santan, dan sirop gula aren secara berlapis. Aduk sebelum diminum.

notes: No piping bag? A zip-top bag with a small corner snipped off, or a bottle cap with holes poked through, works the same way.
Tidak ada plastik segitiga? Kantong plastik berpenutup zip yang ujungnya digunting kecil, atau tutup botol yang dilubangi, bisa dipakai juga.
